## Data Behind Public Dashboards 📊

I did not design these platforms. I am responsible for the **data that feeds them**: I build, curate, and generate the indicators and datasets they display.

### [SIYA: Sistema de Indicadores de los YA](https://ninezya.org/siya/)
A monitoring system of childhood and adolescence indicators in Colombia for the NiñezYA coalition. **I build and maintain the indicator data** behind it, from multiple administrative and survey sources, across three successive releases.

### [Maternal and Child Health Dashboard](https://imagina.uniandes.edu.co/especiales/maternoinfantil/)
A monitoring platform for Fundación Éxito tracking **22+ health indicators across 1,101 Colombian municipalities**. **I cleaned and processed the administrative data** that feeds it.

### [Prevalence and Nature of CSEA: Interactive Data Tool](https://imagina.uniandes.edu.co/especiales/prevalence-csea/)
An interactive tool on patterns of child sexual exploitation and abuse in 17 countries. **I assembled and maintain the Violence Against Children and Youth Survey (VACS) datasets** it displays.

## Code 🛠️

### [Niñez YA](https://github.com/dfmendivelso10/Ninez-YA)
R scripts and data pipeline (raw data → processing → outputs) behind the NiñezYA coalition's monitoring dashboard.

### [Big Data & Machine Learning Problem Sets](https://github.com/dfmendivelso10/Repositorio_Big_Data_2022_Uniandes)

## Working Papers in Preparation 📝

### Intergenerational transmission of childhood adversity in Colombia
A study of **163 caregiver–child dyads** on how Adverse Childhood Experiences are transmitted to child socioemotional outcomes, using mediation analysis within a structural equation framework. *Co-author, IMAGINA Research Center.*

### Prevalence and measurement of childhood adversity in Bogotá public services
A prevalence study of **346 adolescents and young adults across 18 localities**, survey-weighted to represent 1.8M residents, introducing a participatory measurement instrument. *Co-author, IMAGINA Research Center.*
